description: Every root JSON key Podman decodes from the request body of POST /libpod/containers/{name}/update. The wire type is libpod.updateEntitiesWire, which embeds handlers.UpdateEntities, which in turn embeds specs.LinuxResources, define.UpdateHealthCheckConfig and define.UpdateContainerDevicesLimits; all four are anonymous, so encoding/json flattens every one of their fields to the request root. Read by app/internal/filter/libpod_container_update_drift_test.go, which fails when this list and the inspector's gate lists in app/internal/filter/libpod_container_update.go disagree, and by the monthly quality-api-version-watch.yml workflow, which re-derives it from upstream and fails when Podman has grown a field.

also_verified_at.result: all five struct definitions byte-identical to v5.8.1, so this field set is current for Podman 6.x as well

types: containers/podman pkg/api/handlers/libpod/containers.go: updateEntitiesWire (adds Rlimits, same r_limits wire key as the embedded one it shadows)
containers/podman libpod/define/container.go: define.UpdateContainerDevicesLimits (no json tags, so its wire keys are the bare Go field names)
opencontainers/runtime-spec specs-go/config.go: specs.LinuxResources (version resolved from containers/podman go.mod)
regenerate: cd app && SOCKGUARD_TEST_PODMAN_UPSTREAM_REF=<tag> go test ./internal/filter/ -run TestLibpodContainerUpdateSnapshotMatchesUpstreamPodman -v — the failure names every field that moved, in the sorted order this list is kept in.
